You have identified a crucial conceptual linkage: dependencies between groups can be inferred from dependencies between their member items. This insight is key for maintaining the required group contiguity and correct overall order.

Remember that topological sorting is only possible if the dependency graphs (for both items and groups) are directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). If cycles exist in any of the graphs, it means it's impossible to satisfy all constraints. Keeping this acyclicity property in mind will help guide how you structure your approach going forward.
